products.name: Monitaur
products.note: Model monitoring with built-in governance; unified monitoring + governance platform

profile_text.body:
Monitaur is a software company focused on AI governance, describing itself as providing "actionable governance for the entire lifecycle of your AI." Its platform is aimed primarily at enterprise customers in financial services and insurance, and is designed to help organizations establish company-wide standards and controls, unify policies across functions such as underwriting, claims, and risk models, and validate AI models with consistent protocols and transparent reporting. The company positions its software as enabling compliance while also supporting continued AI development and adoption.

The core product, also called Monitaur, is categorized as an AI governance and risk management platform. It combines model monitoring with built-in governance capabilities, covering both internally built models and third-party vendor-provided AI solutions. Published case studies on the company's site reference deployments at a leading insurance provider, an enterprise insurer managing third-party AI projects, and a Fortune 200 company in financial services, though none of these organizations are named. Monitaur also notes a placement in Gartner's inaugural Magic Quadrant for AI Governance in the Visionary category.

The held facts confirm Monitaur has an active page on theworldofai.org and one tracked product. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are noted in the available data.
